instructions: See docs/ratings.md. Give every season a rating on the absolute scale. Rate the player that season, never their career.

seasons.note: Eighteen, eleven starts and seven goals; the acceleration was already terrifying, everything else was unformed.
Bought from Inter at twenty-one on the strength of genuinely frightening acceleration, and eleven league goals in his first season here.
The cruciate injury sustained in 1996/97 and Dalglish's more conservative side left him a rotation defender rather than the composed ball-player of the Keegan years.
An ankle problem cost him much of the season, but at twenty-nine he was still an elite all-round midfielder and Germany’s captain.
A British-record fee for a goalkeeper and, on ability, a fair one: outstanding reflexes and a genuine Scotland number one, in a Sunderland side that gave him a great deal to do.
Seventeen and thrown into a relegated QPR side; rated as the raw teenager.
Thirteen starts and six goals after a 7m move before injury took the season; the form itself was good.
Four starts behind Nesta, Maldini and Costacurta; rated on the Denmark international he already was, not on the minutes.
Injury cut the first Villa season in half. Rated as the established Denmark international and Milan title-winner he was: a genuinely good, ball-playing centre-half.
A rare genuine late peak: fit for a whole season for the first time in years, he was the best centre-half at the club and one of the best in the division, with six goals on top.
Still at that level when the knee gave way in January and ended his career at thirty-one.
African Footballer of the Year two seasons earlier; a genuinely creative number ten in a mid-table Coventry side.
The Euro 2004 golden boot season carried into a genuinely sharper year: elite acceleration and a much improved first touch, still a narrow all-round game.
The one season the finishing caught up with the running: twelve goals before a January move to Manchester City.
The season that made him: the driving force of a Wigan side that finished tenth, and an England-squad conversation by the end of it.
Four games into his Fulham career he ruptured a knee ligament and lost fifteen months. Rated as the player he was in those four games, not on the minutes.
